title: Expanded supervision guidance for litigation work after Mazur judgment
summary: The SRA has expanded its supervision guidance after the Court of Appeal ruled in Mazur on what non-regulated staff can do under supervision when conducting litigation. It advises firms to check their arrangements are lawful.
what_changes: The guidance covers how and when tasks are delegated to non-regulated staff.
It explains how a solicitor can show responsibility through direction, management, supervision and control.
It adds expanded sections for supervisors and supervisees, with case studies.
The SRA expects firms to take a risk-based approach to supervision, tailored to their circumstances.
who_it_applies_to: SRA-regulated firms that delegate work to non-regulated staff, especially firms conducting litigation.

history.event: SRA published expanded supervision guidance following the Court of Appeal judgment in Mazur.
